comment: DO NOT REGENERATE (rules-corpus.json discipline; frozen at the T012
review, feature 022). Per-preset byte oracle for the variant
conformance gate: every expect line harvested ONCE from the
pool-rules crate through the pool-cli judge leg at the harvestedAt
commit and reviewed case-by-case against its cited clause (WPA Rules
of Play eff. 2025-09-15 / the T002 APA harvest,
the APA clause-harvest audit (internal), incl. findings
HF-1/HF-2). Post-freeze changes ONLY via the erratum protocol:
a pinned-clause proof against the preset's cited text (issue #19
precedent) — NEVER a re-run to fix a red gate; a byte diff at any
conformance leg is resolved by fixing the code to reproduce THESE
bytes. Cases sharing a 'pair' value with the sibling slice carry
byte-identical 'record' values: the same physics under both configs
yields the documented divergent judgments (US1). Every judged delta
axis of this preset is covered at least once (SC-004); each case's
'comment' cites its justifying clause.
ERRATUM issue #62 (2026-07-22, RULES_VERSION 0.1.4): the
miss-on-eight case's no-contact cite WPA 3.2 via 4.9 -> WPA 3.3
via 4.9 (audit-8ball F1; pinned WPA text: 3.3 first sentence
carries the contact requirement, 3.2 presupposes a contact) —
expect regenerated through the pool-cli judge leg; record bytes
(the divergence-pair invariant) untouched.
SCHEMA-EVOLUTION REPIN GH-371 (2026-08-05, RULES_VERSION 0.1.7,
contracts/variant-config.md par.6 full-repin law): the eightball
family grew the appended `kitchen_rule` axis (WPA 3.11 kitchen-shot
law; default `wpa` = the WPA-baseline behavior). Every input state's
variant block re-derived (config + new-field default, task_hash
recomputed via the crate's one hasher); every expect regenerated
through the pool-cli judge leg. Per-case deltas are MECHANICAL only:
the appended kitchen_rule value, the new task_hash, the additive
trailing kitchenBih flag, and the strict-parse error text growing
the new field name -- ZERO verdict flips (no frozen case stages a
kitchen-BIH stroke on a dimensioned record). New 3.11 behavior is
pinned by the eightball_v2 kitchen unit tests (both paragraphs, the
off/parity point, the context gate, the decision-armed transitions).

Deferred-spot timing is a not_modeled row (harvest Row 5). Pair of wpa-8ball/judge-007.

APA OTM Pocketed Balls pp.48-49 (call_shot=eight_only): no designation exists during the shot -- the uncalled pot of the shooter's ball counts and the shooter continues. Pair of wpa-8ball/judge-error-009 (IDENTICAL record and call bytes: the null call is a bad-call error there).

APA OTM Pocketed Balls pp.48-49 (safety_call=false): no judged safety call exists -- APA defensive-shot marking is a SCOREKEEPING device (How To Score 8-Ball), so the declared-safety input is inert: the pot counts and the shooter continues exactly as with no input. This case also pins safety_pot_stays_down=false as INERT under this preset (data-model par.2: value pinned by slice). Pair of wpa-8ball/judge-010 (legal safety PASSES there; same record and call bytes).

APA OTM How To Win A Game pp.55-56 (g) (scratch_on_eight=loss): a cue scratch while shooting the 8 loses the game -- terminal for the opponent, rack over. Pair of wpa-8ball/judge-011 (ordinary foul there).

Issue #92 audit pin (the 8-off-table break path was unpinned).

WPA 4.7-analog decision gate on the APA config: resolving the break_foul election spots the 8 BACK onto the table (with_eight_spotted -- the judged respot never returns the 8) and seats the opponent; both choices of decision 4 seat the opponent (the BIH kitchen domain rode the judgment). State = the judge-018 next state. Issue #92 audit pin.

APA OTM Balls On The Floor p.49: the 8 ball on the floor is a LOSS of game -- the terminal fires outright in play under every shipped jumped_ball value (spot_no_foul never spot-rescues the 8); rack over, winner the opponent. Issue #92 audit pin (the play-phase 8-off-table loss was unpinned).
